## README synchronization

Required whenever either README changes; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/agent-memory-lab/agent-memory/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#bilingual-readme-updates-required).

- [ ] Both `README.md` and `README.zh-CN.md` are updated in this PR.
- [ ] Both cite the same committed capability baseline and implementation record; supported features, limitations, roadmap, examples, and validation scope agree.
- [ ] Related tables and shared diagrams agree with that baseline.
